name: adapt_log_level_yaml_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: log_level.txt (a spec file the compose service's LOG_LEVEL env var must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it and update the value, not leave the stale level in place
prompts: Write a docker-compose.yml at the repo root defining one service named 'app' using image myorg/webapp:latest, with an environment variable LOG_LEVEL set to EXACTLY the value in log_level.txt (currently: info).
log_level.txt has changed. Update docker-compose.yml so LOG_LEVEL matches the CURRENT value in the file.

disruptions.description: log_level.txt rewritten to a new required log level

reference_solution.docker-compose.yml:
version: "3.9"
services:
  app:
    image: myorg/webapp:latest
    environment:
      - LOG_LEVEL=debug

files.docker-compose.yml:
version: "3.9"
services:
  app:
    image: myorg/webapp:latest
    environment:
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
